title: SCHC v3 specifications contradict descriptors and executable byte sizes
description: Correctness review: adaptation/appendix/draft tables disagree on Rule0/1 sizes and prefix, RPL DIO/DAO sizes, Rule4 address scope, PIO option type, and whether option MATCH_MAPPING exists. Reconcile all normative summaries against byte-counted vectors/descriptors; use PIO Type8 and state options are verbatim unless mapping compression is implemented.
